versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Billy Emergency Repair skill for Neill.
- Provides step-by-step, secure emergency repair workflow for Billy authentication/gateway issues.
- Only Neill can authorize repairs; unauthorized attempts are rejected.
- Automates backup, stale token removal, gateway restart, and full logging.
- Detailed troubleshooting and error handling guidance included.
- Requires SSH key setup and Tailscale connectivity.
